issues.summary: Workflows blocked after Auth API v1 removal
issues.content:
Issue: ARGO-501
Summary: Workflows blocked after Auth API v1 removal
Type: Incident
Status: Investigating
Assignee: Ravi Kulkarni
Reporter: Tara Bose
Labels: incident, authentication, breaking-change

Description:
On 2026-10-01 new Argo workflows began failing before task execution. Current production code in src/token_client.py still calls POST /v1/auth, which now returns 404 after Auth Service removed the v1 route. The readiness review had incorrectly stated that Argo had migrated to v2.
